author: Today1870
quote: Tormented Souls isn't just a horror game; it’s a true time machine that instantly takes us back to the golden era of the 90s! For anyone who experienced the original Resident Evil 1, 2, and 3 back on the PS1, this game feels like an absolute dream come true. The developers nailed the return of fixed camera angles—building genuine tension with every corner you turn—paired with dark, atmospheric settings and clever, rewarding puzzles that actually force you to think instead of holding your hand.From limited saving ribbons and nostalgic safe room melodies to strict resource management, every single mechanics was crafted with deep respect for classical survival horror. Even the slightly cheesy voice acting brings a smile to your face, serving as a charming throwback to the iconic 1996 original!An outstanding title that proves the classic survival horror formula never dies—it only gets better with time.
